title: Los Angeles Hollywood Sign & City Tour by Helicopter
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Hollywood from a completely new perspective on this luxurious helicopter tour, designed for film buffs, photographers, and first-time visitors alike. Take off and soar over the Hollywood Hills, getting up-close aerial views of the Hollywood Sign, one of the world’s most famous landmarks.

Your experienced pilot and tour guide will reveal insider secrets of the film industry, from historic movie studios to celebrity hotspots, sharing fascinating stories about Hollywood’s rise as the global center of cinema. Capture perfect photos of iconic landmarks, including the Hollywood Walk of Fame, El Capitan Theatre, and the Chinese Theatre, all framed by the sprawling cityscape of Los Angeles.

This tour also includes breathtaking views of Downtown LA skyscrapers, Griffith Park Observatory, the Hollywood Bowl, and the Staples Center, providing a complete Hollywood aerial experience in style and comfort.
